columns.temp_c: MODELLED — diurnal downscaling of NCM monthly normals
columns.rh_pct: MODELLED — diurnal downscaling of NCM monthly normals
columns.wind_kmh: MEASURED (monthly) — NCM normals, held flat within the month
columns.ghi_wh_m2: MODELLED — NCM daily GHI distributed by solar geometry
columns.heat_index_c: DERIVED — NWS Rothfusz on modelled temp/RH
columns.temp_shaded_c: DERIVED — measured shade relief applied to modelled temp
columns.rh_shaded_pct: DERIVED — Magnus relation on the shaded temperature
columns.heat_index_shaded_c: DERIVED — NWS Rothfusz on the shaded condition
columns.comfort_gain_c: TARGET — heat index reduction delivered by shade
columns.comfort_band: DERIVED — project comfort thresholds on exposed heat index
columns.doy_sin: ENGINEERED — cyclical encoding of day of year
columns.doy_cos: ENGINEERED — cyclical encoding of day of year
columns.visitors_est: MODELLED — demand response to comfort, see build_hourly

spatial.note: shade_hours is COMPUTED by ray-traced occlusion over sampled daylight hours; summer_heat_index_c is DERIVED from it.

legend.MEASURED: observed by an instrument and published by the source organisation
legend.COMPUTED: deterministic physics or astronomy, no estimation involved
legend.MODELLED: reconstructed by a documented model — carries model error
legend.DERIVED: an exact function of other columns in this table
legend.ENGINEERED: a feature built for the machine learning models
